All of these artists were alive at the time of their exhibitions, except **Hilma af Klint**, who had passed away in 1944.  

**Conclusion**

Among the 2022 special exhibitions that focused on a single artist at Moderna Museet, the only one that featured a deceased artist was *Hilma af Klint – The Ten Largest*. No other singular‑artist shows in that year involved artists who were already dead.
